notes.title: April 28th 2025 - Class Unique Ability Update and Inconsistent Impact Fix
notes.content:
[h1][i][b]Changes:[/b][/i][/h1]
[list]
[*] Classes all have 4 unique abilities they gain/empower as they level.
[*] These abilities use Energy, which will regenerate slowly, and drop from enemies.
[*] Equipment is now all cycled using one key to make class abilities easily accessable.
[*] Added vote to skip wave timer button in the ESC menu when a timer is active.
[/list]

Abilities are WIP but are mostly stable.


[h1][i][b]Fixes[/b][/i]:[/h1][list]
[*] Actually FIXED Enemies not always being hit by bullets and stuff.
[*] Skirmishers being hard to headshot past their shield.
[*] Escape pod sometimes not spawning at mission end.
[/list]


[h1]([i][b]Possibly Fixed[/b][/i])[/h1][list]
[*] HUD Elements from other mission types remaining after mission vote.
[/list]

notes.title: March 1st 2025 - Patch Silver Wolverine - Melee Combat Update
notes.content:
Fixes:
[list]
[*] Hit Collision on Enemies is more accurate.
[/list]

Changes:
[list]
[*] Melee weapons can now hit more than one target
[*] Melee weapons have a power attack
[*] Melee weapons can Guard.
[*] 
[/list]

Upcoming:
Melee Weapons guarding will be further expanded upon, allowing counter attacks, and perfect parrying.
Menus are having greater clarity brought to them
Melee weapon models are being improved
Enemy Models are being improved.

notes.title: Jan 30th 2025 - Patch Green Rhino - Fixes and Changes
notes.content:
Reworked:
Ingame Inventory is more refined now.
Inventory slots are now 1-5 instead of 1-9.
1 = Melee Weapons, 2 = Secondary Weapons, 3 = Primary Weapons, 4 = Usable Items, 5 = Medical Kit

Drones are now classified as passive items, and will be stored in a passive item inventory for convenience.
You will now start with a melee weapon, and a secondary weapon, along with your primary weapon.
Weapon Select Menu has been made into a more compact and easier to read format.
Ingame shop category menu is now a list with names instead of icons on a grid.


Removed:
Envelope notification icon from chat system from main menu and ingame hud.


Fixed:
Enemies sometimes not recieving damage, as in bullets passing through, explosion not hitting.
Medical Kits bought from arsenal causing a crash.
Items sometimes being visible while taking out a weapon.
Medical Kits not correctly applying visuals on clients.
Drone statistics display in Store not accurate.
Fixed some Assault Rifles having no materials applied.

notes.title: Jan 27 2025 - Patch Purple Giraffe - Bugfixes and Ingame Wiki
notes.content:
Added:
Ingame Wiki with Enemies and Mission Types categories
More categories are being worked on.
Early Access Disclaimer notice at start.
Option to skip tutorial for new players.

Fixed:
Mission type selection not working correctly.
Underground Base generating incorrectly.
Demon Eggs on the Exterminate mission type not being burnt by lingering damage like fire.
Black sided grass in Jungle.
Missing Textures on Standard Weapons.
Sabotage mission objectives not progressing.

notes.title: Jan 25th 2025 - Patch Blue Flamingo Changelog
notes.content:
Reworked:

-Drones now have a duration instead of an ammo capacity, preventing massive stacking of drones over time.
-Drones now have a limited range of 30 meters.



Fixed:

-Difficulties not being any different from Normal.
-Equipment getting in unarmed combat mode when selling items.
-Key bindings menu not working correctly.
-Grass lighting black on one side.
-Modification Menu Related Issues.
-Trees sticking through the tree house in the jungle map blindingly.
-Tutorial not being skippable by leaving.

notes.title: Demo - Major Graphical and Gameplay Update Pre Full Release
notes.content:
The graphics and gameplay have been drastically updated in Shadow Survival, and now the demo is updated so that you may get an early look before the full release, check it out!

See the video below to see some clips of various combat methods.
[previewyoutube=IVao8pM24GA;full][/previewyoutube]


It is up to you how you do battle, find what suits you best, and fight for survival against hordes of demonic forces in the darkness.

notes.title: Shadow Survival Demo - Update 1.5
notes.content:
Working hard on Shadow Survival, I know the demo needed more content, so here you go!

[previewyoutube=qj4VMRI5C2w;full][/previewyoutube]

Be warned, the tier 3 enemies are very dangerous and hard to put down, be prepared for wave 7 on up.

There are 4 choices of augmentations to use in the demo, each with a unique ability.

Rain of Fire 1
Subzero Wave 1
Lightning Barrage 1
Summon Zombies 1


Enjoy the new changes to the demo!

notes.title: Shadow Survival - Bug Fix Patch #3 - Custom Crosshair System Added
notes.content:
Players can now make custom crosshairs in Shadow Survival, adjusting many aspects of the aiming reticle, and some weapon recoil bugs have been fixed.
